project.name: Avalon services without people
project.objective: Show each service through tangible outputs, equipment and empty environments without any humans.

creative_system.visual_thesis: Highly realistic still-life and environment photography whose focal subject is the service itself.
anti_goals: People or human figures anywhere in the image

palette.contrast: Natural material contrast with a restrained service-specific accent

creative_system.composition: One strong central subject, composed for 4:3 and near-square crops.
creative_system.camera: Grounded commercial photography using normal and short telephoto perspectives.
creative_system.lighting: Plausible window or practical studio light.
creative_system.typography: Service labels and descriptions remain live HTML. Incidental illustrative interfaces use minimal copy.
creative_system.interface: Clear hierarchy, responsive reflow, keyboard access, and reduced-motion parity.
invariants: No people, body parts, hands, faces, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, mannequins, humanoid robots or human figures in artwork or on screens.
Synthetic illustrative scenes, not actual client deliverables or events.
permitted_variations: Each service has a distinct physical subject, composition and material palette.

shots.action: Create a high-end commercial photograph for a creative agency service page. The subject is the service's tangible work, never a person. Photographic realism: physically plausible materials, small surface imperfections, coherent perspective and contact shadows, restrained color grading, natural optical depth. The main subject must remain recognizable in a centered near-square crop, while the full image is composed beautifully. No people, body parts, hands, faces, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, mannequins, humanoid robots, or human figures in printed artwork or on screens. No floating objects, holograms, fantasy interfaces, visualized glowing networks, exaggerated CGI polish, watermarks, fake endorsements, performance claims or tiny invented text. An overhead editorial photograph of a real campaign strategy table on pale warm-grey paper. A large folded research map anchors the centre, with a clear graphic timeline of five large muted terracotta and dark-green blocks, a few neatly grouped cream research cards, one closed report folio and a black pencil. Small binder clips physically hold two overlapping sheets. Printed content is simple blocks and lines with no readable statistics or fine text; not a precise data chart. Visible paper fibres, subtle creases and genuine ink. Asymmetric but intentional working arrangement, not a perfect generic flat lay. Broad daylight from the upper left, gentle shadows, 50mm overhead lens. The work feels substantial, carefully considered and premium.
